title: Contact form
summary: Name, email, topic and message. The form almost every website needs.

title: NPS survey
summary: The standard 0 to 10 recommend question with a follow-up that changes with the score.

title: Bug report
summary: Steps to reproduce, expected and actual result, environment and severity.

title: Feature request
summary: Starts with the problem, then the idea, how much it hurts and how often it comes up.

title: Waitlist signup
summary: Email plus three questions that help you decide who gets access first.

title: Newsletter signup
summary: Email, first name, topics and an explicit consent checkbox.

title: Support request
summary: Category, urgency and details first. Account and invoice fields only show when they’re relevant.

title: Product demo request
summary: For SaaS sales teams. Qualifies by role, company size and timing before asking for a work email.

title: Event RSVP
summary: Yes or no first. Guests and dietary needs only appear for people who are coming.

title: Job application
summary: Role, contact details, resume, experience, US work eligibility and start date for one opening.

title: User research screener
summary: Finds interview participants by role, product usage and availability.

title: Beta tester application
summary: Picks early users by role, platform, usage and willingness to give feedback.

title: Cancellation survey
summary: Why customers leave, with follow-ups for price, missing features, usability and switching to a competitor.

title: Product-market fit survey
summary: The Sean Ellis “how disappointed would you be” survey, plus a short exit path for people who stopped.

title: Support satisfaction survey
summary: Resolution, CSAT and customer effort after a support conversation, with a follow-up when it went badly.

title: Event feedback
summary: Overall rating, best session, highlights, what to change and whether people would come again.

title: Workshop registration
summary: Attendee details first, then attendance mode, experience level, and dietary and access needs.

title: Client onboarding
summary: Billing details, key contacts, brand assets and access, collected once when a client signs.

title: Security vulnerability report
summary: Responsible disclosure intake: affected asset, type, impact, reproduction steps and credit.

title: Time off request
summary: Leave type, dates, half days, handover and approver for small teams without an HR system.

title: Expense reimbursement
summary: One expense per request: date, category, amount, receipt, business purpose and approver.

title: Team pulse survey
summary: A one-minute check-in: eNPS, workload, clarity, manager support and recognition.

title: Return or refund request
summary: Order, then each item with its reason, condition and refund or exchange, plus a photo of the problem.

title: Partner or affiliate application
summary: Affiliates describe their audience and channels, agencies their clients. Contact and payout email last.

title: Talk proposal (CFP)
summary: Call for papers: talk title, format, level, abstract, reviewer notes and speaker bio.

title: Testimonial request
summary: Collects a short quote, the result a client got and permission to publish it.

title: Project inquiry
summary: For studios and agencies. Project and budget first, a short path for small budgets, then scope and contact.

title: Supplier registration
summary: Legal entity, tax, address, insurance and offering details to set up a new vendor. No bank details.

title: Volunteer application
summary: Interests, skills, availability and contact details, plus a parent or guardian for volunteers under 18.

title: Membership application
summary: For gyms, fitness studios and sports clubs. Plan, billing, health screen, emergency contact and waiver.

title: Training plan quiz
summary: Goal, experience, schedule and equipment in one-tap questions, then an email to send the plan.

title: Coaching intake
summary: Focus area, goals and preferred format before a first coaching session.

title: Maintenance request
summary: For tenants and facilities teams. Unit, issue, urgency, photos and permission to enter.

title: Rental showing request
summary: For landlords and property managers. Property, move-in date, household, income, pets and showing times.

title: Legal consultation request
summary: Area of law, deadline, a short summary and a conflict check. Nothing confidential up front.

title: Home repair quote
summary: For trades and home services. The job, the property and the timing first, then how to reach the customer.

title: Photography booking inquiry
summary: Shoot type, date, location and coverage, so you can quote before the first call.

title: Catering inquiry
summary: Event type, guest count, service style and dietary needs for a catering quote.

title: Pet adoption application
summary: Home, household and experience questions for shelters and rescues.

title: Patient appointment request
summary: First contact for a clinic: visit type, preferred times, insurance and contact details. No medical history.
